rollCalls.title: Relates to energy efficiency improvements and certain alterations to multiple dwellings
rollCalls.summary: Provides for energy efficiency improvements to certain windows; relates to certain alterations concerning windows and HVAC equipment in multiple dwellings.

rollCalls.title: Extends provisions relating to public hearings on proposed rules
rollCalls.summary: Extends provisions relating to public hearings on proposed rules until January 1, 2028.

rollCalls.title: Assesses a separate tax on distributions from designated settlement funds
rollCalls.summary: Assesses a 100% tax on distributions from the federal anti-weaponization fund; provides that such tax shall not be reduced pursuant to any deduction, exemption or credit.

rollCalls.title: Extends the effectiveness of certain provisions relating to the establishment of certain water charges for hospitals and charities in New York city
rollCalls.summary: Extends the effectiveness of certain provisions relating to the establishment of certain water charges for hospitals and charities in New York city from September 1, 2026 until September 1, 2028.

rollCalls.title: Permits Yates county assistant district attorneys and assistant public defenders to reside in Monroe county
rollCalls.summary: Permits Yates county assistant district attorneys and assistant public defenders to reside in Monroe county.

rollCalls.title: Relates to a competency restoration workgroup to evaluate
rollCalls.summary: Establishes a competency restoration workgroup to evaluate and improve the efficiency and effectiveness of the competency restoration process as it relates to defendants who are being evaluated and receiving restoration under article seven hundred thirty of the criminal procedure law to permit legal proceedings to resume without undue delay.

rollCalls.title: Relates to e-scooter mobile app disclosures
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits electric scooter service platforms operating a digital network from operating electric scooters in this state unless such platform displays a warning that persons under 18 years of age are not allowed to operate electric scooters through the platform; imposes a penalty for violations.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes Cong Ahavas Yisrael, Inc. to receive retroactive real property tax exempt status
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes the Cong Ahavas Yisrael, Inc. to receive retroactive real property tax exempt status for the 2026 assessment roll and all of the 2025-2026 school taxes.

rollCalls.title: Provides that a microbusiness licensee authorized to conduct retail sales may serve as a processor and cultivator for purposes of cannabis showcase event permits
rollCalls.summary: Provides that a microbusiness licensee authorized to conduct retail sales may serve as a processor and cultivator for purposes of cannabis showcase event permits.

rollCalls.title: Relates to winter road maintenance data collection and monitoring
rollCalls.summary: Establishes a standardized statewide system for collecting, recording, and monitoring winter road maintenance operational data in order to improve efficiency, enhance transparency, and support the protection of water resources in the state of New York; requires calibration of all deicing material application equipment used for winter highway maintenance on public roads.

rollCalls.title: Enacts the "no gambling ads for kids act"
rollCalls.summary: Enacts the "no gambling ads for kids act" under which certain covered platforms and social media platforms are prohibited from advertising a service permitting gaming-related gambling, predictive market wagering, online sweepstakes gaming, sports-related gambling, and/or traditional online gambling to minors.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes Hachaim Veshalom to file an application for a retroactive real property tax exemption with the county of Nassau assessor
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes Hachaim Veshalom to file an application for a retroactive real property tax exemption with the county of Nassau assessor.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes Joseph Fredrick to take the competitive civil service examination for the position of police officer and be eligible for employment as a full-time police officer with the village of Allegany
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes Joseph Fredrick to take the competitive civil service examination for the position of police officer and be placed on the eligible list for employment as a full-time police officer with the village of Allegany.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the Islip Terrace Volunteer Exempt Firefighter's Benevolent Association
rollCalls.summary: Relates to the Islip Terrace Volunteer Exempt Firefighter's Benevolent Association; makes technical amendments to the chapter incorporating such association.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the review of joint proposals in rate proceedings
rollCalls.summary: Requires both the department of public service staff and the utility to provide separate, substantive responses to discovery requests and cross-examination questions seeking evidence or explanations related to elements of the joint proposal and explain how any contested aspect of the joint proposal delivers outcomes for utility consumers that are in compliance with all applicable laws and are at least as favorable as would have resulted had its testimonial position been approved by the public service commission.

rollCalls.title: Relates to reimbursement for nonpublic school safety equipment grants
rollCalls.summary: Provides that reimbursement payable for grants for nonpublic school safety equipment shall be paid within twelve months of the nonpublic school furnishing all required application materials for such grant to the department of education; requires the commissioner of education to report on any such reimbursements payable.

rollCalls.title: Provides for a line of duty presumption for disabilities of deputy sheriffs in certain cities
rollCalls.summary: Provides for a line of duty presumption for disabilities of deputy sheriffs in a city with a population of one million or more.

rollCalls.title: Provides for a disability retirement for certain deputy sheriff members of a retirement system in certain cities
rollCalls.summary: Provides for a line of duty disability presumption for any condition of impairment of health caused by diseases of the lung, resulting in total or partial disability or death of certain deputy sheriff members of a retirement system in certain cities.

rollCalls.title: Relates to requirements associated with contracts between state agencies and not-for-profit organizations
rollCalls.summary: Relates to requirements associated with contracts between state agencies and not-for-profit organizations including an advance payment of 25% of the total award to cover expenses incurred in the first quarter.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the supervision of athletic trainers
rollCalls.summary: Increases the number of athletic trainers that a physician can supervise at one time from four to six.

rollCalls.title: Relates to contracts between state agencies and not-for-profit organizations
rollCalls.summary: Relates to provisions governing contracting between state agencies and not-for-profit organizations including new, renewal, and extension contracts.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes the city of New York to sell certain lands now or formerly under the waters of Whale Creek otherwise known as Wyckoff Creek, which was a tributary of Newtown Creek
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes the city of New York to sell certain lands now or formerly under the waters of Whale Creek otherwise known as Wyckoff Creek, and formerly a tributary of Newtown Creek.

rollCalls.title: Establishes the New York state rural ambulance services task force
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the New York state rural ambulance services task force to conduct annual studies on the availability of ambulance services in rural areas and to make recommendations upon the findings of such studies; requires the department of health to submit an annual report detailing the findings of such studies.

rollCalls.title: Establishes the New York State grid reliability and energy affordability transition (GREAT) act
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the New York State grid reliability and energy affordability transition (GREAT) act; establishes the virtual power plant program to help reduce energy costs and grid reliability risks; provides incentives to participants for supporting the grid by investing in distributed energy resources and reducing net energy costs.

rollCalls.title: Relates to a prohibition on chatbot toys
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits the manufacture, exchange, distribution and sale of chatbot toys in this state.

rollCalls.title: Provides for eligibility of certain participants in the New York City employees retirement system to opt into the twenty-five year retirement program for EMT members
rollCalls.summary: Provides for eligibility of certain participants in the New York City employees retirement system to opt into the twenty-five year retirement program for EMT members.

rollCalls.title: Establishes a twenty-five year retirement program for members of the NYC employees' retirement system employed as water supply police
rollCalls.summary: Establishes a twenty-five year retirement program for members of the NYC employees' retirement system employed as water supply police; provides for employer pick-up of certain additional member contributions required to be made by certain participants in the 25-year retirement programs.

rollCalls.title: Relates to expanding opioid overdose prevention measures in certain settings
rollCalls.summary: Requires school districts, public libraries, BOCES, county vocational education and extension boards, charter schools, and non-public schools to provide and maintain on-site opioid antagonists; requires the department of health to provide such opioid antagonists to such entities upon request.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes an optional 20-year retirement benefits plan for Elmira traffic officers
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes an optional 20-year retirement plan for traffic officers employed by the town of Elmira, who submit an application therefor within one year of the effective date of such provisions, or within one year of start of employment.

rollCalls.title: Includes seizure detecting monitors for certain infants under standard coverage for Medicaid recipients
rollCalls.summary: Includes seizure detecting monitors for certain infants under standard coverage for Medicaid recipients; limits coverage to one monitor.

rollCalls.title: Provides for the transfer of service credit between certain retirement systems
rollCalls.summary: Provides for the transfer of service credit by a member of the New York city police pension fund into the New York city police pension fund.

rollCalls.title: Provides a heart disease presumption for certain members employed as probation officers
rollCalls.summary: Provides a heart disease presumption for members employed as a probation officer, supervising probation officer or probation officer trainee of a department of probation in a city with a population of one million or more.

rollCalls.title: Enacts the New York state good guardianship act
rollCalls.summary: Enacts the New York state good guardianship act to establish the statewide initiative of not-for-profit guardians.

rollCalls.title: Relates to placing restrictions on the sale of flare guns
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the crimes of criminal sale of a flare gun in the first and second degrees; sets restrictions on and requirements for the sale of flare guns.

rollCalls.title: Grants retroactive membership in the New York city teachers' retirement system to certain employees
rollCalls.summary: Grants retroactive Tier IV membership in the New York city teachers' retirement system to certain employees employed by the city of Yonkers parks department for the period beginning in 2009 and ending in 2014.

rollCalls.title: Permits New York city correction and sanitation members to borrow from accumulated contributions; repealer
rollCalls.summary: Permits New York City correction and sanitation members to borrow from accumulated contributions to their retirement plans.

rollCalls.title: Requires certain construction project contracts to include siting of renewable energy systems, qualified energy storage systems, or electric major utility transmission facilities
rollCalls.summary: Requires certain construction project contracts with a value of greater than or equal to five million dollars to include siting of renewable energy systems, qualified energy storage systems, or major electric transmission facilities.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the determination of salary base for members of the New York city police pension fund
rollCalls.summary: Relates to the determination of salary base for members of the New York city police pension fund; provides that the salary base for members of the New York city police pension fund whose employment with the police department of the city of New York commenced on or after July 1, 2000 shall be determined in the same manner as members whose employment commenced prior to such date.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes the assessor of the town of Brookhaven, county of Suffolk, to accept an application for a real property tax exemption from Ministerios Sion, Inc.
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes the assessor of the town of Brookhaven, county of Suffolk, to accept an application for a real property tax exemption from Ministerios Sion, Inc. for all of the 2024 general taxes and all of the 2023-2024 school taxes.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes Frank R. Smith to receive accidental performance of duty disability retirement benefits
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes Frank Smith, a New York city police detective, to receive accidental performance of duty disability retirement benefits for illness suffered as a result of exposure to disease during undercover assignments as a member of the police department of the city of New York.
